note: Gunnison NF (GMUG) campground 1 mile SW of Almont on CO-135 along the Gunnison River, ~8,000 ft, in walking distance of the Almont Gorge where the East and Taylor rivers join; aspen and cottonwood. 10 primitive sites but 5 are tent-only; the ~5 RV-capable sites are small and rigs over ~35 ft may struggle in the turnaround, so a 23-ft EKKO fits the larger ones. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed first-come only (rec.gov Scan and Pay), $18 single site (+$9 extra vehicle) as stored, vault toilets and hand-pump water. Added season May 23 - Oct 1 (weather dependent). Neither page states a site count, tent/RV split, lengths or hookups (left as stored). Note: dropped the amenity/FCFS/fee/season restatements.
flags: Missing phone: the FS page lists only the Supervisor's Office (970-874-6600); the Gunnison Ranger District, which runs it, is (970) 641-0471 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/offices).

Site count/fit unverified: no agency page states the 10 sites, the 5 tent-only sites or any length; rec.gov's catalog holds one placeholder site. The stored count 10 and the note's 'about 5 RV-capable sites' rest on the old sweep note only.

Waterfront (stored riverview): on Esri imagery the campground is a small loop and spur between CO-135 and the Gunnison River; the loop sits ~40-100 m from the channel behind a strip of willow/cottonwood, the spur road runs closer along the bank. No site points to place individual sites; riverview looks right, no contrary claim.
Pin 38.6553,-106.85563 is the FS/rec.gov facility point, at the loop entrance off CO-135, inside the campground. Fine.

Status: the FS page header reads 'Site Closed' on 2026-10-28, after its stated Oct. 1 season end - an ordinary seasonal closing, not recorded as a status. No GMUG alert or forest order names Almont or CO-135.
